system.description:
A voice of the underclass in Mournas and every city like it: satirists, protest singers, broadsheet writers. Art as disruption.

  • Hostile Crowd: your Fascinate works on a wary or hostile audience outside combat if you perform for 1 round uninterrupted first; so does Sway Crowd once you have it. When a creature fails its save against your Discord, one ally who can hear you can move up to half its speed towards it.
    • 9th level: the ally can move its full speed.
  • Underground Voice: Advantage on Bardic Lore checks on a city's criminal history, underground movements and rebellions.
